cues.en: There are a lot of videos in this course that have the word code challenge in the title.
cues.zh: 課裡很多影片，標題有Code challenge。

cues.en: These videos are a crucial part of your learning experience and this course, but they are not your typical lectures.
cues.zh: 它們是學習的重要部分，但不是典型講課。

cues.en: Instead, they contain a bunch of related exercises where you will get to pause the video and code up
cues.zh: 而是相關練習，讓你暫停、在Python寫，

cues.en: some analyses and visualizations in Python.
cues.zh: 分析與視覺化。

cues.en: And so in this video, I'm going to explain what these code challenge videos are, how to learn from
cues.zh: 這段解釋程式挑戰是什麼、如何學習，

cues.en: them, and the multiple ways that you can engage with these videos depending on your level of coding skills and your learning goals.
cues.zh: 以及依程式程度、學習目標，如何以多種方式參與。

cues.en: So all of the Code challenge videos have a similar timeline.
cues.zh: 全部挑戰有類似流程。

cues.en: I start each of these videos with a high level overview of the important topics that you will learn and practice in that video.
cues.zh: 先概述這段會學、會練的重要主題。

cues.en: Each code challenge is cut up into a sequence of exercises that build on each other towards a final product by the end of the video.
cues.zh: 各挑戰分成一串相互累積的練習，最後完成作品。

cues.en: Sometimes there's two exercises, sometimes there are 6 or 7.
cues.zh: 有時兩個，有時六七個。

cues.en: Depends on how complicated the project is.
cues.zh: 取決專案複雜度。

cues.en: And for each individual exercise, I will explain the specific instructions, the parameters or settings
cues.zh: 每個練習，會解釋特定要求、需要的參數或設定，

cues.en: that you might need to use, formulas that you might need to translate into code, and so on.
cues.zh: 以及要轉成程式的公式等等。

cues.en: And when the exercises involve data visualizations, I will also show you screenshots so that when you
cues.zh: 涉及視覺化，也會給截圖，讓你，

cues.en: are coding and working through the exercise, you will know whether you got the right solution by checking
cues.zh: 寫程式時，能核對解法正不正確，

cues.en: what you see in your Python notebook file compared against what I show here in the video in the slides.
cues.zh: 比較筆記本和影片投影片的畫面。

cues.en: Now, after I explain the instructions for the exercise and possibly giving some hints or tips.
cues.zh: 說完要求，也許給提示、技巧後。

cues.en: You will see a screen that looks like this.
cues.zh: 會看到這畫面。

cues.en: And this is where I will say that now you should pause the video.
cues.zh: 這裡會說，現在該暫停。

cues.en: Switch from the video to your code notebook file, and do your best to solve the exercise and create the visualizations that I explained.
cues.zh: 切到筆記本，盡力解題，做出說明的視覺化。

cues.en: Now, I do not expect you to be able to complete all of the exercises completely on your own with no help.
cues.zh: 不期待你完全沒幫助，就能獨自完成全部練習。

cues.en: Obviously, that's why you are here.
cues.zh: 所以才來這裡。

cues.en: If you could do all the exercises completely on your own, with no help and no tips and no explanations, then you wouldn't need to be in this course.
cues.zh: 完全不用幫助、提示或解釋就都會，也不必上這課。

cues.en: So after telling you when to pause the video to work through the code, I will then switch my screen to Python and explain the exercise solutions.
cues.zh: 說明暫停時機後，就切到Python，解釋解法。

cues.en: Now, this is not just about me showing some lines of code.
cues.zh: 不只是展示幾行程式。

cues.en: I also go through what the code means, why it works, what some alternatives are, and I explain more about how llms work and how to work with them.
cues.zh: 也解釋意義、為什麼可行、替代方案，並多談LLM如何運作、如何操作。

cues.en: So these code demo explanations are really a core part of this course and part of your learning experience.
cues.zh: 所以程式示範解說，是課程與學習的核心。

cues.en: Anyway, once I finish explaining the code for, let's say, this particular exercise, I will then go back to the slides and explain the goals of the next exercise.
cues.zh: 這個練習解說完，再回投影片，解釋下一個目標。

cues.en: And then we keep cycling through this loop until all the exercises are finished.
cues.zh: 持續循環，直到全部練習結束。

cues.en: And then finally at the end of the video, I will wrap things up with a few key take home messages about the important learning concepts from that video.
cues.zh: 最後，用幾個重要學習重點收尾。

cues.en: There are multiple ways that you can engage with this course and these code challenge videos, depending
cues.zh: 依程式、機器學習、資料視覺化等，

cues.en: on your level of background with coding, machine learning, data visualization, and so on.
cues.zh: 背景，可以用不同方式參與。

cues.en: If you already have a pretty strong background with Python and machine learning, you can try coding the exercises completely from scratch.
cues.zh: Python與機器學習基礎強，可以完全從零寫。

cues.en: That is fantastic.
cues.zh: 非常好。

cues.en: It's amazing and I applaud anyone who does this.
cues.zh: 很棒，為這樣做的人鼓掌。

cues.en: But you definitely do not need to start from scratch.
cues.zh: 但絕對不必從零。

cues.en: Every single Code challenge video is based on code demos that I showed and concepts that I explained
cues.zh: 每個挑戰都根據前面的程式示範與概念，

cues.zh: 很多練習可回頭看，

cues.zh: 複製貼上、修改前面的程式。

cues.en: I will talk more about these helper files in the next slide.
cues.zh: 下一張多談。

cues.en: Another option is to first watch my video explanations of the code.
cues.zh: 另一選擇，是先看我解釋程式。

cues.en: So you get like a high level overview of the code structure.
cues.zh: 掌握整體結構。

cues.en: And then you can go back and code it yourself.
cues.zh: 再回去自己寫。

cues.en: Maybe from scratch, maybe from the helper files.

cues.en: Of course you don't need to code at all.
cues.zh: 當然，也可完全不寫。

cues.en: You can just watch the coding parts of the video without actually switching to Python yourself.
cues.zh: 只看影片的程式部分，不自己切到Python。

cues.en: It's also totally fine.
cues.zh: 也可以。

cues.zh: 但真的建議看解答部分。

cues.zh: 如剛說，不是給幾張程式截圖，馬上帶過。
